about: With CKD, type 2 diabetes and eGFR 46, an initial ACR of 40 and a repeat of 25 mg/mmol within three months qualify without a PCR or an SGLT2 inhibitor supply in the window.

Possible finding: the record holds no line establishing whether the Jardiance pack supplied on 1 October was still being taken on 22 December, when the PCR of 40 mg/mmol completed the kidney criteria.
The eGFR rose from 45 to 55 and the ACR was 70 mg/mmol, but Jardiance was supplied the day after the urine specimen.
